list: Wants names: the best, which one, where to go
task: Wants steps or help with a job

mention_rate: Out of all answers, how many name {B} in the text (a link to its site alone doesn't count).
position: When {B} is mentioned, where it comes in the list of names. 1 = named first.
top_three_rate: How often {B} is in the top three
When {B} is mentioned, how often it's one of the first three names.
win_rate: How often {B} is the top pick
When an answer picks one clear winner, how often that winner is {B}.
capture: When an answer recommends someone specific, how often that includes {B}.
tool_recommendation_rate: How many answers recommend a specific brand or organization at all. Low means AI just gives information.
cohort_sov: Of all mentions of {B} and its tracked competitors, the share that are {B}.
negative_rate: How often AI is critical of {B}
When {B} is mentioned, how often the answer is negative or mixed about it.
fact_accuracy: How often AI gets facts about {B} wrong
Checks claims in answers against a list of verified facts.
owned_citation_share: How often {B}'s website is a source
Of all the websites AI cites as sources (each counted once per answer), the share that are {B}'s own.
citation_split: Whose websites AI uses as sources
Sources split into {B}'s site, competitors' sites, forums and everyone else.

SENTENCE.top_three_rate: {n} of {d} answers that name {B} put it in the top three
SENTENCE.win_rate: when there's one clear winner, it's {B} {n} of {d} times
SENTENCE.capture: {n} of {d} answers that recommend someone include {B}
SENTENCE.tool_recommendation_rate: {n} of {d} answers recommend a specific brand or organization
SENTENCE.cohort_sov: {B} gets {n} of {d} mentions among itself and competitors
SENTENCE.negative_rate: {n} of {d} answers that name {B} are negative or mixed

floor: Track only as a starting point

full: Most questions can be measured. Each topic below has at least one number worth tracking.
partial: A good share of questions can't be measured beyond which websites AI cites. Build the topics that have a main number and skip the rest.
citations-only: Most questions are off-topic for {B}. The only useful thing to track is which websites AI cites.

position: sum of {B}'s rank in each answer
win_rate: answers that name {B} and pick one winner
capture: answers that recommend any specific brand or organization
tool_recommendation_rate: answers that recommend a specific brand or organization
fact_accuracy: claims about {B} that contradict the fact list
owned_citation_share: all cited websites (each counted once per answer)
citation_split: all cited websites (each counted once per answer)
